_readme: Maps a RETIRED abgeordnetenwatch poll-topic label onto the label the same subject carries
in the CURRENT vocabulary. Needed because the topic list was coarsened over time: the
2017-2021 Bundestag tagged polls with 39 distinct topics, the current one uses 23. Without
this, a cross-period question like 'alle Energie-/Umweltabstimmungen seit 2017' silently
drops every poll filed under 'Naturschutz', because that label no longer exists.
Only ever used to ADD a second, current-vocabulary key to a historical poll. The poll's
own original topic string is always kept alongside it (field `topic`), so nothing is
rewritten and the mapping stays auditable.
Two rules when editing:
1. Map only a genuine COARSENING — one retired label whose subject now lives entirely
under one current label. Where a retired label was split across several current ones,
leave it unmapped (see `unmapped` below). Guessing which half a vote belonged to would
file real votes under a topic they were never about, which is exactly the kind of
silent error this site cannot afford.
2. Where data/lobby-topic-map.json already groups the same subject, follow it rather than
inventing a second, conflicting taxonomy — it is why Menschenrechte, Entwicklungspolitik
and Humanitäre Hilfe land under Außenpolitik, and why Familie/Frauen/Senioren land
under Gesellschaftspolitik.
Format: retired label (must match abgeordnetenwatch's field_topics label exactly) ->
current label (must be one of the 23 labels the current legislature actually uses).

unmapped.Innere Angelegenheiten: Split, not renamed: the old Innenausschuss catch-all is today three separate labels (Innere Sicherheit, Migration und Aufenthaltsrecht, Staat und Verwaltung). Which one a given vote belongs to cannot be derived from the label alone.
unmapped.Medien, Kommunikation und Informationste: Half media/culture, half IT. The current vocabulary has no media topic at all, so there is no honest target.
unmapped.Kultur: No current equivalent. Filing it under Gesellschaftspolitik would be an invention, not a merge.
unmapped.Deutsche Einheit / Innerdeutsche Beziehu: A historical subject with no successor label. Left as-is.
unmapped.Verbraucherschutz: Split across at least Recht (the modern committee is 'Recht und Verbraucherschutz'), Landwirtschaft und Ernährung (food safety) and Wirtschaft (trade). Appears on 9 polls of the 2005-2017 terms, 8 of which also carry a mapped topic and so stay reachable anyway; only the 2014 TTIP/CETA arbitration vote is reachable by its original label alone. Mapping it to any one target would file the other two kinds of vote under a topic they were never about.
